__comment: ADR-0039 gives the Engineer's Pick the wrench's DISMANTLE verb, and this tag is what delivers it: dismantle rides the ordinary block-break path, which the Pick already answers with isCorrectToolForDrops, and GregTech resolves what counts as a wrench from tool tags. Confirmed in-game -- a machine breaks and drops its item. The tag does NOT carry the other three verbs, which is worth knowing because it looks as though it should: rotate and the configure verbs are gated on NeoForge ItemAbility declarations (GTItemAbilities.WRENCH_ROTATE, WRENCH_CONFIGURE and friends) that a plain Item answers false to, so ADR-0039's deferral of them to #168 holds as written. One visible seam until #168 lands: GTCEu's rotation overlay draws on `toolTypes.contains(WRENCH) || canPerformAction(WRENCH_ROTATE)` -- an OR whose first half this tag satisfies -- so the overlay appears while right-click does nothing. This is GregTech's own, the tag `GTToolType.WRENCH` is built with. GTCEu reads both it and the NeoForge one next to this file; naming both is cheaper than depending on which check a given machine runs.
